'''Krismo Sodi''' was the leader of the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] on the planet [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] and the brother of [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]]. He led an assault on the [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] and managed to rescue his sister with the eventual help of [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] before the train got to the tyrannical Quarzite leader, [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]].

==Biography==
[[File:KrismoSodi-Bounty.png|thumb|left|250px|Sodi wielding a pair of electro swords]]
Krismo was the most skilled and deadliest member of the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]],<ref name="SWE" /> serving as their leader at the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. From atop a galloping [[Milodon/Legends|Milodon]], he led his warriors through the subterranean caverns of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] against the [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] forces of Lord [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]].

Once he reached the subtram, he grappled with [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] in [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] team, defeating [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]] and [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]] relatively quickly. After killing [[Rigosso/Legends|Rigosso]], Krismo faced Fett himself who, in the ensuing fight, fell on top of the chest his job was to protect, accidentally releasing [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]]. Fett was surprised to see a woman tumble out of the chest and Krismo took advantage of the moment, knocking him out. A moment later, Krismo encountered Asajj Ventress. The two fought, ending with Krismo and Pluma handcuffed. The trio went to the rear of the tram, where Ventress released Pluma for a price. As this was done, Krismo and Pluma left the tram back to their home via [[Milodon/Legends|Milodon]].

==Personality and traits==
Krismo Sodi was protective over his family, especially over [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|his sister]], showing that he loves and cares for them.

==Talents and abilities==
Krismo was a very agile and skilled warrior among the Kage, being able to throw off two armed [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|bounty]] [[Latts Razzi/Legends|hunters]] off the subtram while also managing to incapacitate Boba Fett, and even disarming former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] of her lightsabers before being overwhelmed. He was highly skilled in martial arts as well.

==Behind the scenes==
Krismo appeared in the twentieth episode of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]' [[The Clone Wars: Season Four|fourth season]], entitled [[Bounty (episode)|''Bounty'']]. He was voiced by [[Actor/Legends|actor]] [[Ben Diskin]], who had also voiced [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] in the same episode.
